crossRefs.note: Balaam said to Yahweh’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore…
crossRefs.keyword: displease. Heb. do not evil in the eyes of the lords

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: Therefore now return, and go in peace, that you not displease the lords of the Philistines.”
translations.bsb: Therefore turn back now and go in peace, so that you will not do anything to displease the leaders of the Philistines.”
translations.kjv: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines.
translations.asv: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines.
